title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — September 20, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B4.2 (Peaked September 20, 2026 at 06:38 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 398 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

The Sun's behaving itself. 💫

A broad dark coronal-hole-like region stands out on today’s otherwise relatively quiet Sun.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 211/193/171 Å Composite
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
